instructions.context: The state is the text a customer typed into the order notes field while placing an order in an online shop.
instructions.question: What kind of note is this?
instructions.focus: If the note does more than one thing, choose the part that most needs the shop's attention.

gift-message.what: Words meant for the person who receives the order, to go on a card, a tag or a packing slip.
gift-message.not_for: Instructions to the shop or the courier about packing or delivery.
examples: Happy birthday! Love from Grandma and Grandpa
Congratulations on the new home, from everyone at the office

delivery-instruction.what: Tells the shop or the courier how to pack the order, or where, when or how to deliver it.
delivery-instruction.not_for: Words meant for the person who receives the order.
examples: Leave the parcel behind the side gate if nobody answers
Please gift wrap it and leave the receipt out
Deliver after 5 pm, the office is closed in the morning

question.what: Asks the shop something, or asks for a change to the order, without reporting a problem.
examples: Can you put our company name on the invoice?
Will this arrive before Friday?
Please change the colour to navy if you have it

complaint.what: Says something went wrong or the customer is unhappy, with this order, an earlier order or the shop.
complaint.not_for: Questions or change requests that do not report a problem.
examples: My last order arrived broken and nobody answered my email
This is the third time I have ordered this because the first two never arrived

fraud-signal.what: The note contains a known warning sign of payment fraud or of a scam aimed at the shop.
fraud-signal.not_for: Ordinary gift or delivery instructions, including a gift sent to someone else's address.
examples: Ship it to my freight forwarder, I will send the final address after payment
I used my uncle's card, please ship today before he checks his statement
I paid too much by mistake, please send the difference to this other account

other.what: Anything else: thanks, a remark, a test, or text that says nothing about this order.
other.not_for: A note that fits one of the other options.
examples: Thanks!
Love your shop
test

instructions.context: The state is the text a customer typed into the order notes field while placing an order in an online shop.
instructions.question: How soon does someone at the shop need to act on this note?

criteria.what: Nothing to do: the note asks nothing of the shop.
examples: Thanks!
Love your shop

criteria.what: While packing or delivering: the shop follows the note when the order ships, and no reply is needed.
examples: Happy birthday! Love from Grandma and Grandpa
Leave the parcel behind the side gate

criteria.what: Reply within a day or two: the customer asks something or wants a check, and the order can ship as it is.
examples: Can you put our company name on the invoice?
Will this arrive before Friday?

criteria.what: Before the order ships: the order may need to change or stop, or an unhappy customer needs a reply first.
examples: Wrong address, please send it to my work address instead
My last order arrived broken and nobody answered my email
Ship it to my freight forwarder, I will send the final address after payment
